svg.text: SmolLM2-135M — 7-Behavior Neural Fingerprint Atlas (30 Layers, Zero-Grad Direct Logit Lens)
7×7 Circuit-Location Overlap Matrix (Layer Cosine / Top-128 Neuron Jaccard %)
Blue dots = depth center-of-mass per behavior. High cosine/Jaccard = shared circuit (editing risks cross-talk); low = safely separable.
